vocabulary.definition: goods produced by hand, often with traditional methods
vocabulary.example: The market was filled with beautiful handicrafts made by local artisans.

vocabulary.definition: the action of forcibly taking someone away against their will
vocabulary.example: The authorities are investigating a series of abductions in the area.

vocabulary.definition: causing shock or dismay, very bad or unpleasant
vocabulary.example: The living conditions in the refugee camp were truly appalling.

vocabulary.definition: large landowners who cultivate crops, especially in tropical areas
vocabulary.example: The Planters in the region grew sugarcane and coffee on their vast estates.

vocabulary.definition: of great value or high price
vocabulary.example: She inherited a collection of precious jewelry from her grandmother.

vocabulary.definition: able to be prepared and used for growing crops
vocabulary.example: The agriculturist identified the most cultivatable areas for the new farm.
